issue_request: FHIR-39451 was a Published/Persuasive R5 FHIR-core ExampleScenario change request to add a `title` child to `ExampleScenario.instance.version` for compact human-readable display of instance versions.

additional_context: `source/fhir.ini` actively maps `examplescenario=ExampleScenario`, confirming the inspected StructureDefinition is in build scope. FHIR-I minutes from 2022-11-28 record FHIR-39451 as Persuasive. Zulip searches for the issue terms found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current authoritative source already satisfies the Jira request and no source hunk is needed.
